<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="camel-warriors" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Camel Warriors</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line">[https://runescape.wiki/w/Camel_Warrior <nowiki>Camel Warriors</nowiki>]<nowiki> are one of the 4 Raptor Mobs, generally killed for the collection log. As such, they should </nowiki><strong><nowiki>only be killed on task where they are 5x more likely to drop the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/917025698479210528.png?v=1" alt="camelstaff" title="camelstaff" kind="icon" /></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Camel warriors have one main mechanic - After taking some damage, they split into 3 mirages - Blood, Smoke and Shadow. Each has their own unique abilities. All attack with magic.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shadow mirages - Drains </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> points after charging their overhead bar.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Blood mirages - Heal other mirages for ~900 HP per attack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Smoke mirages - Cast the Confuse, Weaken and Snare spells on the player, reducing hitchance and damage by 5%, and freezing you in place for 10s respectively.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ After the mirages have been killed, the camel warrior re-appears with the HP it had before phasing, and can now be finished off.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Mirages can be bypassed by dealing a singular hit of more than 20,125 damage, before hitcaps apply.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For example, if </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="tuskas" title="tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is used on task in </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with 120 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, it will be capped at 15K, but in theory it would've dealt 30K damage, so the camel will not be phased. This will then allow the player to finish off the camel by dealing the remaining 5125 damage in 1 hit.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the player fails to deal 5125 damage in the next hit, the camel will phase into mirages. This is why perks such as crackling </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1" alt="crack4" title="crack4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and aftershock </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1" alt="as4" title="as4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should be avoided when relying on methods that skip the mirage mechanic.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>All methods suggested below use tricks that bypass the mechanic entirely,</nowiki></strong><nowiki> as it is very time consuming and detrimental to kph to kill Camel warriors &quot;normally&quot;.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill : 4768.8</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: 300 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, 200 AFK</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: ~1.43M (~1m AFK)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="desirable-drops"><nowiki>Desirable Drops</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Camel_staff <nowiki>Camel staff</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/917025698479210528.png?v=1" alt="camelstaff" title="camelstaff" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 5 times rarer off-task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Raptor_key_part_3 <nowiki>Raptor key part 3</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Must be on task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Ugthanatos <nowiki>The Ugthanatos</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1091050888828813412.png?v=1" alt="masterquestcape" title="masterquestcape" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Cursed_amascut_sand <nowiki>Cursed amascut sand</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152063208763433.png?v=1" alt="cursedamascutsand" title="cursedamascutsand" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dropped by any of the 4 Raptor specialty monsters.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><nowiki>Location and How to Get There</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ They can be found on the island east of Sophanem, which is accessed via stepping stones (no </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864819760758844.png?v=1" alt="agility" title="agility" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level needed) near a group of crocodiles. </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The area is affected by desert heat.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The quickest way to get there is via travelling south from Pharaoh's sceptre/Sceptre of the Gods option 2 followed by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofacceleration" title="powerburstofacceleration" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively, one can go via a gate in the eastern wall of Sophanem that allows access from the city.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-active-melee-posd"><ins><nowiki>Method: Active Melee [PoSD]</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The fastest way to kill camels relies on doing trips to a player owned dungeon with 3-4 camel warriors, using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and trying to kill as many camels as possible within the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> duration while skipping the mirage mechanic. It also requires essentially best in slot melee gear to be as consistent as possible.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>2023-AUG-29 - IMPORTANT NOTE</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="tuskas" title="tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> changes which made the enhanced variant not reset-able with the War's Retreat crystal, this method is significantly worse and will not be able to achieve the advertised kph. However, it is </nowiki><em><nowiki>likely</nowiki></em><nowiki> still better than methods which involves dealing with camel spawns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=IaEAq8JYt0E4KufUW910 <nowiki>Melee - Active</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FIaEAq8JYt0E4KufUW910.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="strategy"><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure your familiar combat setting is on </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Passive.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Occasionally, the camel will not phase despite </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592042399383713.png?v=1" alt="dragonlongsword" title="dragonlongsword" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hitting for significantly less than 20,000. When this happens, use a 188 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1" alt="cleave" title="cleave" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879577612298.png?v=1" alt="sever" title="sever" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to guarantee the kill on the camel. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1" alt="gfury" title="gfury" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994929821727604808.png?v=1" alt="smashgop" title="smashgop" kind="icon" /><nowiki> may not deal sufficient raw damage to finish the camel off.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1" alt="dba" title="dba" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at War's Retreat with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158472839208.png?v=1" alt="asr" title="asr" kind="icon" /><nowiki> equipped + Kalg spec </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1" alt="kalgscroll" title="kalgscroll" kind="icon" /></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Swap to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602561894829522954.png?v=1" alt="terramaul" title="terramaul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1" alt="reaverring" title="reaverring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and get back 90% or more adrenaline before teleporting to the Menaphos house portal.</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Use a Menaphos tablet or the House teleport spell if your house is attuned to Menaphos.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. You can activate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1" alt="excal" title="excal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>from action bar</nowiki></strong><nowiki> without interrupting adren gaining if not on full HP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Travel to the sunken pyramid with Kags (option 1).</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Enter the dungeon using right click. You should fall out of combat and Persistent Rage </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/739965637056659567.png?v=1" alt="persistentrage" title="persistentrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should start topping your adrenaline off until 120% around this time.</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Do a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1" alt="surgemobile" title="surgemobile" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → walk diagonal → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1" alt="surgemobile" title="surgemobile" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378665802235968.png?v=1" alt="divemobile" title="divemobile" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to get to whichever large dungeon hosts your camels (diagram below).</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/314C4Su9Hi.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as you enter the dungeon and turn on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1" alt="grim" title="grim" kind="icon" /></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Step 1 - </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/ZOVInSkksNI <nowiki>6 demonstration</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><strong><nowiki>Camel 1:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Target closest Camel → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="tuskas" title="tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1" alt="punish" title="punish" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> spot where it spawns. If enhanced </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="tuskas" title="tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is on cooldown, use defensive basics </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for adrenaline until you can </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1" alt="overpowerigneous" title="overpowerigneous" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Camel 2:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Walk next to spawn + (tc) + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1" alt="overpowerigneous" title="overpowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + basic</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><strong><nowiki>Camel 3 onwards:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (tc) + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592042399383713.png?v=1" alt="dragonlongsword" title="dragonlongsword" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → basic</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sometimes </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1" alt="overpowerigneous" title="overpowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592042399383713.png?v=1" alt="dragonlongsword" title="dragonlongsword" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will crit and kill the camel on its own, and you will not need to use a basic after.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Cycle basics in the order </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1" alt="chaosroar" title="chaosroar" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1" alt="gfury" title="gfury" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994929821727604808.png?v=1" alt="smashgop" title="smashgop" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1" alt="gfury" title="gfury" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592042399383713.png?v=1" alt="dragonlongsword" title="dragonlongsword" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1" alt="chaosroar" title="chaosroar" kind="icon" /><nowiki> guarantees a kill.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592042399383713.png?v=1" alt="dragonlongsword" title="dragonlongsword" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1" alt="gfury" title="gfury" kind="icon" /><nowiki> crit guarantees kill.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In an ideal run, you should be able to get 7-8 camel KC.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you get a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800920748092.png?v=1" alt="relentless5" title="relentless5" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and lucky crits, a 9 kill run is possible.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/HuDHDp3du2.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When you fail a skip, use (tc) + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to avoid getting rooted and try to spend as much of your adrenaline as possible on other spawns before teleporting out.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/KuRqzaZMl5.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you run out of adrenaline and still have time on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, use (tc) + defensive basics </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> until you have enough adrenaline for another </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592042399383713.png?v=1" alt="dragonlongsword" title="dragonlongsword" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (22.5%)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/3oKetozjs6.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Turn off </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1" alt="grim" title="grim" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when finishing up a trip to preserve charges.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="video-example"><nowiki>Video Example</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/WxDyOaSMxrM <nowiki>Narrated task and example kills</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-afk-cannon"><ins><nowiki>Method: AFK Cannon</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This method involves not engaging in combat with the Camel Warriors at all, relying on cannon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and poison damage </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1" alt="poisonicon" title="poisonicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> which passively kill the Camel Warriors without triggering their mirage mechanic.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics_1"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=9b25a62c-dd22-4055-bfc3-bb0541bdefb3 <nowiki>Melee - AFK</nowiki>]<nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F9b25a62c-dd22-4055-bfc3-bb0541bdefb3.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093437906374696.png?v=1" alt="bookofdeath" title="bookofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used here to increase kph by 10%</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="strategy_1"><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Place the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in the Camel Warrior island, while staying in the tiny island before the stepping stone, as shown below:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/vVgYAkeEST.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Players can do other activities in the meantime (e.g. Fletching </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864817881722960.png?v=1" alt="fletching" title="fletching" kind="icon" /><nowiki>).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To avoid being attacked by camels, players should bring runes for Telekinetic Grab </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/866551637970255872.png?v=1" alt="telekeneticgrab" title="telekeneticgrab" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to collect the drops along with using a legendary pet with the &quot;Scavenge&quot; perk active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do </nowiki><strong><nowiki>NOT</nowiki></strong><nowiki> call your pet as it will end up being on the same small island as you, and will not able to access the drops.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
